## ACE-Step v1 3.5B - the older song recipe (dev copy)

**Why it exists:** the quality question is open (E13), and ACE-Step's *first* generation is a third MIT
candidate with a different recipe - `ace_step_v1_3.5b.safetensors` (7.3 GB, all-in-one, MIT) at **50 steps /
cfg 5**, with `ModelSamplingSD3` (shift 5) and a **`LatentOperationTonemapReinhard`** operation applied
through `LatentApplyOperationCFG` - none of which the 1.5 line uses. It is also the model the official
**m2m editing** template edits with.

**Built flat from `audio_ace_step_1_t2a_song.json`**, reading the text encoder's widget list verbatim from the
template (so `lyrics_strength` - a knob the 1.5 line dropped - is upstream's value); only `tags` and `lyrics`
are replaced with the shared comparison input, seed 31, 120 s latent. **Unlike 1.5, v1's text encoder takes no
duration**, so the length lives only on `EmptyAceStepLatentAudio.seconds` (single consumer).

**What the m2m template showed (the restyle cost-out):** that route is `VAEEncodeAudio` -> `KSampler` at
**denoise 0.3** - a *denoise-based edit*, i.e. the same mechanism E5 measured as **retention, not restyle**,
so that limitation looks structural rather than a settings accident.

**File:** `models/checkpoints/ace_step_v1_3.5b.safetensors` (MIT, `Comfy-Org/ACE-Step_ComfyUI_repackaged`,
`all_in_one/`).

*How to run it: story **S23** in `HOWTO.md`  ·  Why it is this way: **E13c** in `audio/EXPERIMENTS.md`.*

widgets_values: Industrial rock, hammering machine percussion with metallic clangs, distorted bass, cold analog synth, shouted male lead with a gang chorus, gritty lo-fi production, relentless and mechanical

[Verse]
Steel is breathing in the dark
Pistons counting out the hour
Every window blind with sparks
Every hand a kind of power
Hammers fall like steady rain
On the anvil of the day
We are forging something nameless
From the rust and from the clay

[Chorus]
Iron heart, iron heart
Turn the wheel and hold the line
Iron heart, iron heart
Everything we build is mine

[Verse]
Furnace glow along the floor
Shadows walk the factory wall
We have heard the engines roar
And we never once will fall
Oil and smoke and borrowed light
Every rivet set in time
We will work into the night
Till the morning bells will chime

[Chorus]
Iron heart, iron heart
Turn the wheel and hold the line
Iron heart, iron heart
Everything we build is mine

[Bridge]
And when the metal sings
And when the silence breaks
We will know the shape of things
By everything it makes

[Final Chorus]
Iron heart, iron heart
Turn the wheel and hold the line
Iron heart, iron heart
Everything we build is mine

[Outro]
Turn the wheel, turn the wheel
Hold the line
